R8499.summary: Dr Nicholas Wotton, English ambassador in France, reports to Queen Mary that Peter Carew was at Compiègne and spoke with the French king and the Constable, on the English rebels in France, and that the Constable discussed with Carew how the Isle of Wight might be taken and kept.

snip.cap: Harley MS 1582 f. 8r: “Pleasing it your highness to understand that”, then the cipher: Carew was at Compiègne with the French king, the rebels and the Constable
snip.credit: British Library, Harley MS 1582 f. 8r (via DECODE R8499)

system: Graphic-sign letter substitution with 3-6 homophones per letter, about 16 nulls ('Nihil significantia') and a nomenclator of ~150 names and common words (and, the, of, to, was, the Constable, Peter Carew, the rebels, your highness ...). Nulls present.
